## Description

The Medvya-owned screens of the 6 Nov sign-in flow in web/clinic, in the designed two-panel frame (brand panel, help, language, region line): Sign in (work email, "This is a shared computer", continue, passkey and single sign-on entry), which starts the Entra sign-in with the email as a login hint; Create account step 1 (practice type, name, city) and step 2 (name, email, mobile, "I'm the doctor" / "I manage the clinic"), which feed the existing sign-up (MDV-P1-004) before the Entra account is made; invitation acceptance (what the role can and cannot see, full name, expiry); choose location (last used first, signed in as, not you); and signed out / session ended. The email code, MFA set-up and recovery codes are Entra pages and are branded in MDV-P1-060. No password, code or factor is ever handled by Medvya.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a staff member enters their email, when they continue, then the browser goes to the Entra sign-in with the email as login hint and Medvya stores nothing about it.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given "This is a shared computer" is chosen, when the session starts, then it uses the shared-device idle lock and maximum session the server already enforces, decided on the server.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an expired or revoked invitation, when it is opened, then the screen says so and offers to ask the practice for a new one; no account is created.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a user with several locations, when they sign in, then the last used location is listed first and choosing one sets the server-side facility.
- [ ] **AC5.** Every screen is keyboard-complete with visible focus, announced errors and 44 px targets; axe is clean in en, hi and ar; Arabic is right to left.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
